security_audit.summary: Most execution and reconnaissance detections are false positives from Markdown fences, inline file names, CSS, comments, and JavaScript RegExp.exec. The real risks are external CDN and font loads in generated artifacts, plus a trust risk from a community skill requiring Anthropic-branded output.

remediation.suggestion: Vendor p5.js and fonts with the skill or clearly disclose that generated artifacts load cdnjs and Google Fonts.
Replace mandatory Anthropic branding with neutral styling or require clear attribution that the artifact is user-generated and not official.

content.value_statement: Generative art requests often need reproducible code, parameters, and a polished viewer. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create seeded p5.js art artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Uses p5.js randomSeed and noiseSeed for reproducible visuals.
Builds from an included viewer template with seed controls.
Defines interactive parameter controls for exploration.
Produces a single HTML artifact with inline art logic.
Includes PNG export and seed navigation patterns.
limitations: Generated artifacts load p5.js and fonts from external CDNs by default.
The skill does not include automated visual regression testing.
It guides browser-based p5.js work, not native app packaging.
Visual quality depends on careful prompt direction and model tuning.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Generative Artwork
use_cases.description: Turn an abstract visual idea into a reproducible p5.js artwork with controls.

use_cases.title: Teach Creative Coding Concepts
use_cases.description: Show seeded randomness, noise fields, particles, and parameters through an interactive browser artifact.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Systems for Products
use_cases.description: Generate controlled visual studies for campaigns, dashboards, or branded experiences.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one interactive artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an original algorithmic artwork about quiet rainfall. Include a short philosophy, seeded p5.js output, and three useful controls.

prompt_templates.title: Tune a Visual System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create generative art inspired by magnetic fields. Use seed navigation and controls for field strength, particle count, and trail opacity.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Themed Series
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for variations from one algorithm.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a generative series about urban growth. Provide one shared algorithm, explain the philosophy, and highlight five distinct seeds.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt an Existing Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that starts from a defined aesthetic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a p5.js artwork that feels precise, sparse, and mathematical. Avoid copying named artists. Make the parameter design explainable.

output_examples.input: Create an artwork inspired by tidal memory.
output: A movement called Tidal Residue with a concise computational philosophy.
An interactive viewer with seed navigation, wave density, drift, and erosion controls.
A reproducible visual system where each seed changes the shoreline pattern.

output_examples.input: Make a particle-based piece for a gallery wall.
output: A refined particle field concept with adjustable force, count, trail fade, and palette controls.
A browser-ready artifact that can regenerate, reset, and export the current seed as an image.

best_practices: Start with a specific visual concept and let parameters follow the concept.
Use fixed seeds when comparing variations or sharing results.
Review external CDN use before publishing artifacts publicly.
anti_patterns: Do not request copies of living artists or copyrighted works.
Do not remove seed controls from the interactive viewer.
Do not add unrelated libraries unless the user needs them.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates original p5.js generative art with a philosophy, seeded randomness, and an interactive HTML viewer.

faq.question: Can it make repeatable artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses seeded randomness so the same seed can reproduce the same result.

faq.question: Does the output need a server?
faq.answer: No. The intended output is a single HTML artifact that runs in a browser.

faq.question: Can users adjust the artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. The template includes parameter controls, seed navigation, reset, regenerate, and image export patterns.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What should reviewers check before publishing?
faq.answer: Review external CDN dependencies, branding language, and whether generated art avoids copying protected styles.
